output.review_comment: The `end < start` antisymmetry handling is fine, and the half-open `(start, end]` counting may be the right fix. But the `has_weekend_holiday` / `end_condition` logic is a hack. Whether a holiday falls on a weekend has nothing to do with whether `end` is counted. Weekend days are already excluded, so a weekend holiday should never change the result. With this patch, adding an irrelevant Saturday holiday (even one far outside the range) silently drops a day from the count. That contradicts the docstring and looks like it was reverse-engineered from specific test cases rather than the spec. Please remove that branch and use one consistent boundary rule. If a test still fails after that, explain the conflict in the PR (and add a description) instead of special-casing inputs.
